as_told.title: The Hottel memo on the FBI website

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, talks about the Hottel memo, a note to an official of the FBI, the US federal police agency, named Guy Hottel. Michels says it is the most-read document on the FBI's website, and that it describes an Air Force officer writing to Hottel in 1952 about a crashed UFO with an alien crew inside. When he tells it another time, he dates it to 1950, says an Air Force technical officer came upon a crashed craft, and doesn't mention a crew. Either way it would mean the government knew of a crashed craft early on.
